prompt_text: I need braces or Invisalign in Houston. Which specific orthodontists should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Houston for braces or Invisalign?
competitors_mentioned: Texas State Board of Dental Examiners
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — to give specific names and phone numbers I need one quick detail: what ZIP code or Houston neighborhood are you nearest to (or are you willing to travel across the city)? Also tell me: are you an adult, teen, or child, and do you have insurance you want to use?

If you’d like to start now without giving location, here’s a fast, practical plan plus an example call script and what to look for so you pick the right orthodontist for braces or Invisalign.

What to ask / look for when you call or book a consult
- Are you a Board‑certified orthodontist? (Check American Board of Orthodontics at abo.org.)
- How many Invisalign cases do you treat per year? (More experience → better for complex adult cases.)
- Am I a candidate for Invisalign, or would braces be better for my bite/needs?
- Do you use intraoral scanning (no goopy impressions)?
- Typical treatment length and estimated cost range; what’s included (retainers, refinements, X‑rays)?
- Payment plans, insurance/assignments accepted, and whether you file benefits.
- What’s your emergency policy (broken bracket/poking wire)?
- Can I see before/after photos of similar cases and patient references or reviews?
- Who does progress adjustments — the orthodontist or an assistant?
- Retention plan (type of retainers, duration, cost of replacements).

How to evaluate providers quickly
- Preference order: Board‑certified orthodontist > licensed dentist offering “Invisalign” without orthodontic specialty training.
- Look for Invisalign Platinum/Diamond status if you want Invisalign — it indicates high case volume.
- Read Google/Yelp/RealSelf reviews and look at before/after photos on the practice site or Instagram.
- Verify Texas license and any disciplinary history at the Texas State Board of Dental Examiners website.

Where to look by Houston area (suggestions)
- Galleria / Uptown
- Memorial / Spring Branch
- Heights / River Oaks
- Upper Kirby / West University
- Southwest Houston / Sugar Land / Katy (if you’re west/southwest)
If you tell me which area/ZIP, I’ll fetch 4–6 specific, highly rated orthodontists near you (with phone numbers, short notes on why each is a good pick and what to ask them).

Quick call script you can read verbatim
“Hi, I’m calling to schedule a consultation. Can I ask whether your office has a board‑certified orthodontist, and whether you have experience treating adults/teens with Invisalign? Also, do you accept my insurance (name insurer), and do you offer a free or low‑cost initial exam? Finally, do you use digital scanning for impressions?”

Next step
Give me your ZIP code or neighborhood (and tell me whether you prefer Invisalign over braces) and I’ll return a short list of 4–6 specific orthodontists in Houston to call, with phone numbers and a one‑line reason for each.
